definition: fraction of reference sequences on which the frozen instrument reproduces the same coordinate assignment when re-run, and under resampling of the derivation panel
reason: a rerun and a derivation-panel bootstrap are both fully defined operations with no external truth requirement. This is the Stage 2B analogue of g2's cross-frame comparison, which already has a landed precedent at median Jaccard 0.955
allowable_claim: mapping reproducibility, with the resampling scheme named
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called accuracy or validation

definition: residue offset between the observed catalytic [YF]xDD and the coordinate the instrument assigns to it
reason: the only landmark whose position on an arbitrary RT is fixed by the residues rather than by a model. Two constraints carry over from the failed round-2 design and are binding: the motif and a declared window must be MASKED from derivation, features and thresholds; and the denominator must be motif-positive sequences only, because 56 of 66 historical proteins and an unmeasured fraction of any broad panel carry no literal match, while 4 of 66 carry two
allowable_claim: landmark localization offset on motif-positive sequences, with multiplicity reported
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called boundary accuracy; must not use an all-sequences denominator

definition: dispersion of assigned coordinates across a declared perturbation ensemble - derivation-panel resampling, alignment method, profile parameters, and the family composition of the panel
reason: well defined and computable. The Stage 2B ensemble MUST vary panel family composition, which is the axis the round-2 design omitted and the reviewer named as a blocker
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called a confidence interval on a true boundary

definition: fraction of sequences on which conserved anchors appear in the reference order
reason: computable without external truth, but a decoder can ENFORCE order, in which case the quantity measures the decoder rather than the sequence. It is identifiable only for methods that can emit out-of-order output, and the method's capacity to violate order must be demonstrated first
allowable_claim: ordered-anchor rate, for methods demonstrated capable of emitting disorder
prohibited_phrasing: the word recovery is prohibited where order is enforced by construction

definition: fraction of sequences in an unseen or held-out RT class receiving a complete, unambiguous, ordered coordinate assignment
truth_source_or_none: none - a property of the instrument on a population
reason: a rate with a declared denominator. Stage 2B makes this genuinely testable for the first time, because a 45-family derivation panel CAN hold out whole families - which the 66-protein single-class historical substrate could not
allowable_claim: class-level transfer rate, per held-out class
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called accuracy; a successful mapping is not a correct mapping

definition: E05 stratified by best identity and bidirectional coverage to the derivation panel
reason: identity distance and class novelty are SEPARATE axes and are reported jointly in a two-way table, never collapsed
allowable_claim: transfer rate by identity bin and class status
prohibited_phrasing: must not conflate distance with novelty

quantity: region occupancy / non-detection by RT class
definition: per (class, region) distribution over the call-state vocabulary
reason: the DISTRIBUTION is measurable and is the central downstream product. The BIOLOGICAL reading - that a class lacks a region - requires the positive-control chain in E08 and is not licensed by the distribution alone
allowable_claim: call-state distribution by class, with inspectability retained
prohibited_phrasing: NOT_DETECTED may never be reported as absent, lost, or lacking

quantity: biological absence of a region in a class
definition: the claim that a region is genuinely not present in the RT class, rather than not mapped
identifiable: UNESTABLISHED as of now; PARTIALLY_ESTABLISHABLE if the evidence chain below is built
reason: the chain required before the word absent is permitted: (i) the instrument detects the region in a positive-control class at a declared rate; (ii) the sequences are full length and inspectable, so the region could physically have been shown; (iii) mapping succeeds in the flanking regions on the same sequences, so failure is local rather than global; (iv) the result survives the derivation-panel perturbation ensemble; (v) an independent instrument or a structure agrees. Until all five hold, the state is NOT_DETECTED_INSPECTABLE
allowable_claim: with the full chain: region R is not detected in class C at rate X while detected in class D at rate Y, under conditions (i)-(v)
prohibited_phrasing: absent, lost, lacks, missing - none of these until the chain is complete
denominator: inspectable full-length sequences of that class

quantity: RT0 in retrons versus group II introns
definition: whether an RT0-corresponding region is detectable in GII RTs but not in retrons
reason: three independent obstacles, all measured: (1) the myRT window on LtrA is 90-360 and Blocker's RT0 zone is M1-R85, so every myRT-derived substrate has the region EXCISED and can never address it; (2) g2 created no RT0 block and the defining cross-class claim was NOT_TESTABLE_ON_SUBSTRATE; (3) the prior project's RT0 number was OBJECT_MISMATCH. A full-length substrate plus a non-LTR comparison class plus the E08 chain would be required
prohibited_phrasing: no RT0 occupancy, rate, presence or absence of any kind

definition: whether a sequence-assigned anchor occupies a homologous structural position, and whether operational regions map principally to fingers, palm or thumb
truth_source_or_none: structural feature assignment, in a different representation
reason: a containment and correspondence question, orthogonal to the sequence instrument PROVIDED no structure contributes to derivation. Constraints carried forward: LtrA/5G2X is the historical coordinate carrier and is excluded; tag offsets are unresolved (U11); the structural panel's RT-class coverage is the binding limit on what can be asked
allowable_claim: structural correspondence, per structure, after the sequence instrument is frozen
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called independent validation of the coordinate system
denominator: structures in the arm after exclusions

definition: reproducibility of the inferred length and position of sequence lying between consecutive conserved anchors
truth_source_or_none: the query's own residue numbering for length; the ensemble for position
reason: inter-anchor LENGTH is a direct measurement on the query once anchors are placed, so it is the most robust architecture quantity available - more robust than any region edge. Its POSITION inherits anchor uncertainty. g2 has a landed precedent: the widest spacer at LtrA 230-304 reproduced across both frames and separated from the null at p=0.0050
allowable_claim: inter-anchor spacing distributions by class, with anchor uncertainty propagated
prohibited_phrasing: must not be described as domain-boundary-delimited insertions
denominator: sequences with both flanking anchors placed

definition: true start and end of a conserved region
reason: unchanged from the previous two rounds and not reopened. No population supplies true region boundaries; the historical sources state a procedure and no residue edges

definition: whether the instrument assigns the correct RT family
reason: Stage-1's 42 family labels are produced by the myRT classification system, so testing a myRT-derived instrument against myRT-derived labels is the same instrument twice. Nothing local supplies independent family truth
prohibited_phrasing: must not report family assignment accuracy, precision or recall

quantity: phylogenetic eligibility of the extracted core
definition: whether extracted homologous-core positions are fit for Stage 06 inference
reason: eligibility requires homologous-column coverage, order, ambiguity bounds, insertion masking, truncation status and exclusion of non-homologous class-specific regions - each of which is a separate measurement Stage 2 does not make
allowable_claim: candidate core substrate, with per-sequence coverage and ambiguity fields so Stage 06 can apply its own criteria
